notes.title: May Update
notes.content: This month we have added the Aliens!! special card. Make sure to watch out for their powerful laser.

notes.title: March Monthly Update
notes.content: Add the Rune throwable to the game. This Throwable increases in power after each foe it hits.

notes.title: Splash Screen Not closing Hot Fix
notes.content:
- Allows for players to press space to get through the Splash Screen
- Mouse Does Damage in the air now
- Gigantic bomb has correct UI Image

notes.title: A lot of bug fixes
notes.content:
- Achievement bugs for From the Grave
- Map not unlocking
- Player tags not matching
- Other minor Fixes

notes.title: Achievement Patch 2
notes.content:
Fixes issue with unlocking the final map
Fixes issue with From the Grave achievement.
